reviews.text:
Unusable. Love the art in this deck - but it’s unusable. All text is displayed in a huge font that is clipped off on the right and left sides of the display area. When I scroll down, only the first few sentences are displayed and it won’t scroll further. 

Happy to send screenshots if that might help. Using an iPad Pro running IOS 17.2. 

Please fix - I want to use this beautiful deck!

Text no longer displaying entire message. I liked the deck well enough, but this one, my Unicorn deck, and my Wisdom of the oracle decks no longer show all the text in the window, nor allow me to scroll to read the entire message. Please fix!

update. there was a recent update to this app and it was more effective prior.
4 stars beforehand though
Love the Fairies. I love this. I hope it comes out in print to be able to physically hold the cards. 😊

Legit and precise. I just got these. I’m shocked at how precise it is. My Faery doll is on point. I just had a tarot card reading the other day and these Faery cards like the Faery circle one said the same things that the tarot cards said when I had a reading with a lady the other day. It was my first time ever. Kinda scary! These are legit and the Faery spirits will only reveal the truth to encourage and help you.
Simply beautiful. These are beautiful. I keep checking the website because they would be amazing to have in print.

Absolutely gorgeous. Very beautiful stunning deck. The most beautiful I have ever seen fairy deck. And very accurate readings.
I hope they make a card deck with this!!
Love these cards!. I would love a hard copy of these cards.
Faeries. I actually miss the older version as it had more to say. These are nice however and very pretty!
Beautiful App. I love the messages and the beauty of this app! Would recommend to all ages🧚🏼‍♂️
This game. Love the photos
Buggy and unresponsive. This program needs some work it does not work correctly is unresponsive I have to tap on the cards repeatedly to get them to open total waste of time!
Beautiful. Very accurate and beautiful artwork.

Favorite Tarot Cards. These cards ALWAYS know what's going on in my head, and when I don't know what's going on in my head, they surprise me with really good advice. All cards are positive and encouraging which I find incredibly helpful as we are all on a journey to find and maintain self-life and happiness.
Gorgeous cards Great insight. Absolutely love this app!

Beautiful Deck!!. The pictures are beautiful and the messages are extremely relevant to my questions and/or situations in my life. The descriptions are thoughtful and insightful yet easy to read and not too long. Great app!
Love this App. The art is beautiful and the the card meanings are thoughtful and it is great to give readings with this amazing deck.
Beautiful and accurate. These cards are truly beautiful and the advice is really helpful and accurate.
Perfect. Super happy with this, use it daily :-)
Oracle review. It's a wonderful app
Fairies App. Great App. Lorna
